svg.aria-label: Way Back, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.0. The first command of this version copies state.sqlite before it migrates; the way back is that copy and the earlier binary. 1: Operator to This version: serve or state show. 2: This version to state.sqlite.v1: VACUUM INTO, mode 0600, never replaced. 3: This version to state.sqlite: step 2: table tokens, generation row. 4: Operator to Earlier binary: start on the migrated file. 5: Earlier binary to Operator: refused: state.sqlite has schema 2, this binary knows schema 1. Way back by hand. 6: Operator to This version: stop the server. 7: Operator to state.sqlite: move state.sqlite, -wal and -shm away. 8: Operator to state.sqlite.v1: rename state.sqlite.v1 to state.sqlite. 9: Operator to Earlier binary: start the earlier binary. 10: Operator: changes of users, roles, realms and tokens since the upgrade are lost.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry way back
